subject.title: feat(ui): Labs settings page for experimental feature toggles

question: Should Settings → Labs become the supported Control UI surface for enabling experimental capability gates, beginning with Code Mode?
rationale: The implementation is not only a route and toggle: it establishes the discoverability, warning language, and configuration-writing pattern for future experimental features such as Swarm.

options.title: Sponsor Labs as the experimental-gates surface
options.body: Approve the Labs pattern after the stale-config recovery fix, with Code Mode as the first supported entry.

options.title: Limit this to a Code Mode-specific setting
options.body: Keep the existing capability discoverable but avoid creating a general experimental-feature registry until the broader product direction is approved.

options.title: Defer experimental UI controls
options.body: Keep configuration-file enablement as the supported path until the Swarm and Labs product boundaries are decided together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Labs as the experimental-gates surface
recommendation.body: Approve the Labs pattern after the stale-config recovery fix, with Code Mode as the first supported entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked proposal and this PR show the strongest available ownership signal for the Labs and Swarm product direction.
